mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the mean return in such cases is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1400.0, or the average return in such cases is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 104.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where INDPRO falls below 104.0, or the average return in such cases is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand strength that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that leads to higher real yields and equity market repricing, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, which increases wage growth expectations and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 153000.0, or the interaction signal fails to achieve a Rank IC above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong underlying demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
